alt: Diagram of the two PS5 menu paths to check before launch: Settings > Storage and Control Center > Downloads/Uploads, with the 212 GB free-space advice.

data.title: Check storage and downloads first
data.body: PS5 storage: Settings > Storage. PS5 downloads: Control Center > Downloads/Uploads. Keep at least 212 GB free (PlayStation's advice).
data.tip: Xbox path is general. Check the names on your console.
